web.description:
## Get Started Models & Pricing [Grok 4.6](https://cursor.com/docs/models/grok-4-6) # Grok 4.6 grok-4.6 256k Cursor We recommend using [Grok 4.7](https://cursor.com/docs/models/grok-4-7) for stronger self-verification and longer-running work. ## [Effort levels](https://cursor.com/docs/models/grok-4-6#effort-levels) On the [Start plan](https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing#start-india-only) (India only), Grok 4.6 is fixed at medium effort at standard speed. ## [Pricing](https://cursor.com/docs/models/grok-4-6#pricing) Grok 4.6 is part of the [Cursor Models pool](https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing#cursor-models) on individual and team plans. This pool also includes Grok 4.7, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5. Standard on-demand usage is priced at $2/M input tokens, $0.50/M cached input tokens, and $6/M output tokens. The Fast variant is priced at $4/M input tokens, $1/M cached input tokens, and $12/M output tokens. [Grok 4.6](https://cursor.com/docs/models/grok-4-6) | $2 | - | $0.5 | $6 | | ![Cursor](https://cursor.com/docs-static/images/providers/cursor.svg)
[Grok 4.6 (Fast)](https://cursor.com/docs/models/grok-4-6) | $4 | - | $1 | $12 | ## [Cursor Token Rate](https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing#cursor-token-rate) On Teams and Enterprise plans, third-party model requests include a Cursor Token Rate of $0.25 per million tokens. ## [Auto modes](https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing#auto-modes) Third-party models also incur the [Cursor Token Rate](https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing#cursor-token-rate).

GPT-5.3 Codex draws from the third-party **Other Models** pool, which charges at the rates below.
